name: Gossip And Lies
overview: Scripture firmly condemns gossip and lies as destructive behaviors that harm the community and dishonor God. Believers are instructed not to raise false reports or join with the wicked in unrighteous testimony, nor to act as talebearers among their people. The Word calls for guarding the tongue from evil and deceit, warning that those who secretly slander their neighbors will face divine judgment. Such conduct is described as foolish and an abomination to the Lord, demonstrating that truthfulness and integrity are essential marks of a Christ-centered life.
